test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The child grew up cheerfully listening to ___________ stories.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**endless**" is appropriate because** it conveys the idea that the stories the child listened to were numerous and never seemed to stop, which fits the context of the sentence.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The child grew up cheerfully listening to **endless** stories."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Few:** Indicates a small number, which doesn't fit the context of "cheerfully" and frequent storytelling.
 
• **Horror:** Implies scary stories, which doesn't align with the cheerful mood described.
 
• **Sad:** Conveys a negative emotion, which contradicts the cheerful nature of the stories.
